Wayanad landslide kills five; conflicting blame attributed to contractor and rainfall

A significant landslide occurred at a tunnel project site in Wayanad, Kerala, resulting in five deaths and leaving several missing. The incident, triggered by heavy rainfall, has led to a dispute over accountability. While some reports indicate the government is blaming the contractor, a state minister suggested the PWD should not be held responsible, implying the landslide was 'man-made' due to natural causes.
